name: chart
title: Chart
description: Beautiful charts. Built with d3 and Marko — server-rendered, themeable with CSS variables. A shadcn theme's `--chart-1..5` variables restyle every chart with zero changes. Text scales with container width (the SVG uses a fixed viewBox — the price of zero-JS SSR); only the tooltip hydrates.
importSnippet:
import Chart from "@/components/ui/chart/chart.marko";
import ChartBar from "@/components/ui/chart/bar.marko";
accessibilityNotes: Charts are pure SSR SVG plus one small client hydration for hover tooltips — there is no keyboard navigation or `accessibilityLayer`-equivalent focus ring today (upstream's Recharts `accessibilityLayer` prop, which adds keyboard access and screen-reader summaries, has no port here — a component-source gap, not a docs gap).
Chart color is never the only signal in a well-built chart: pair every series color with a label in the legend or tooltip (`ChartConfig.label`) rather than color alone.
The tooltip's indicator + label + value are read together in DOM order, so screen readers announce a coherent row per series when the tooltip is inspected.

examples.title: Add an Axis
examples.source:
import Chart from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/chart/chart.marko";
import BarChart from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/chart/bar.marko";

static const chartData = [
  { month: "January", desktop: 186, mobile: 80 },
  { month: "February", desktop: 305, mobile: 200 },
  { month: "March", desktop: 237, mobile: 120 },
  { month: "April", desktop: 73, mobile: 190 },
  { month: "May", desktop: 209, mobile: 130 },
  { month: "June", desktop: 214, mobile: 140 },
];

static const chartConfig = {
  desktop: { label: "Desktop", color: "#2563eb" },
  mobile: { label: "Mobile", color: "#60a5fa" },
};

<Chart config=chartConfig class="h-[200px] w-full">
  <BarChart
    data=chartData
    config=chartConfig
    xKey="month"
    xTickFormatter=(value) => value.slice(0, 3)
    tickMargin=10
    tooltip=false
  >
    <@series dataKey="desktop" radius=4/>
    <@series dataKey="mobile" radius=4/>
  </BarChart>
</Chart>
examples.description: Grid plus an `xTickFormatter` that slices each month name down to 3 letters, with `tickMargin=10`.

props.name: config
props.description: Same object passed to <Chart> — Marko has no context, so it's passed twice.

props.name: xKey
props.description: Category field for the x axis, e.g. "month".

props.name: cursor
props.description: Vertical cursor line on hover (recharts default). Shadcn area demos pass false.

props.name: grid
props.description: Horizontal grid lines (recharts <CartesianGrid vertical={false}/>).

props.name: stackOffset
props.description: "expand" ⇒ 100% stacked (recharts stackOffset="expand"). Requires stacked series.

props.name: tooltipLabelFormatter
props.description: Applied to the tooltip's label row only (recharts ChartTooltipContent labelFormatter).

props.name: width
props.description: viewBox size — the container's CSS aspect scales the drawing.

props.name: xTickFormatter
props.description: Applied to axis tick labels only (like recharts' XAxis tickFormatter).

props.name: xTickMinGap
props.description: Minimum pixel gap between kept x-axis ticks (recharts XAxis minTickGap) — thins dense date-series ticks.

props.name: yAxisTickCount
props.description: Approximate number of y-axis ticks (recharts YAxis tickCount). Default 5.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Curve type (recharts `type`). Default "natural", like the shadcn demos.

attributes.name: stackId
attributes.description: Series sharing a stackId stack on top of each other (declaration order = bottom to top).

attributes.name: gradient
attributes.description: Fill with a per-series <linearGradient> fading the series color 0.8 → 0.1.

props.description: Additional concentric rings — e.g. chart-pie-stacked's inner/outer donut pair. `data`'s own ring uses `dataKey`/`nameKey`/`innerRadius`/`outerRadius` above as ring 0.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Sector border width (recharts Pie strokeWidth, default 1). 0 removes the white separator.

props.name: width
props.description: viewBox size — the container's CSS aspect scales the drawing.

parts.name: centerLabel
parts.description: Rendered inside the svg, receives the pie center — for donut text.

parts.name: sliceLabel
parts.param: { x: number; y: number; row: Row; value: number; index: number; }
parts.description: Custom label rendered at each slice's centroid — e.g. value-in-foreground-color or category-name-in-background-color.

props.name: label
props.description: Resolved x label — already run through the chart config by the caller.

fields.name: dataKey
fields.description: Which field to render — defaults to the bar's own dataKey (value labels).

fields.name: color
fields.description: CSS color (e.g. "var(--foreground)" or "var(--color-label)"). Default currentColor via fill-foreground parity class.

concepts: Every chart takes the same `config` object twice: once on `<Chart>` (which emits a scoped `<style>` resolving `--color-<key>` per theme) and again on the chart tag itself (Marko has no context/provider primitive, so the config can't be read implicitly by descendants). Each config entry's `color` can be a literal (`"#2563eb"`), an `hsl()`/`oklch()` string, or a `var(--chart-1)` reference into the 5 `--chart-1`..`--chart-5` custom properties a shadcn theme defines for light and dark — swap the theme and every chart restyles with zero code changes. Reference a resolved color from series data or Tailwind with `var(--color-<key>)`, e.g. `fill="var(--color-desktop)"` or a `fill-(--color-desktop)` utility class.
